headline: Ocean-freight stress is HIGH and holding — 42.2/100; Bosporus Strait is the lead driver, -20% vs normal

bullets.text: Global Ocean Freight Stress is **42.2/100** (**high**), flat week-over-week. 5 of 28 monitored chokepoints are disrupted.
The biggest driver is **Bosporus Strait**, running **72.0/day** vs a normal of **90.6/day** (-20%).
**392** changes to the disruption set since the last update.
Also moving now: **Bohai Strait** is running **28% below** normal.
Market context: Brent crude **$125.44/bbl** (-0.06% prev_close) — context for the energy-route chokepoints, not a stated cause.
Against the loaded sample trade book, **$377.5M** routes through disrupted lanes — an estimated **$997K** cost-of-delay ($519K–$1.6M).
